original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-precompose-property-local-source}
Let $\tau \in \{fpqc, fppf, syntomic, smooth, \etale, Zariski\}$.
Let $\mathcal{P}$ be a property of morphisms which is $\tau$ local
on the source. Let $f : X \to Y$ have property $\mathcal{P}$.
For any morphism $a : X' \to X$ which is
flat, resp.\ flat and locally of finite presentation, resp.\ syntomic,
resp.\ \'etale, resp.\ an open immersion, the composition
$f \circ a : X' \to Y$ has property $\mathcal{P}$.
stage_a_standalone_statement_draft: Let $\tau$ be one of Zariski, fpqc, fppf, étale, smooth, or syntomic. A property $\mathcal P$ of morphisms of schemes is *$\tau$-local on the source* if for every $f:X\to Y$ and every $\tau$-covering $\{a_i:X_i\to X\}$ one has $\mathcal P(f)$ if and only if $\mathcal P(f\circ a_i)$ for every $i$. If $\mathcal P$ is $\tau$-local on the source and $f:X\to Y$ has $\mathcal P$, then for any $a:X'\to X$ in the class corresponding to $\tau$—flat for fpqc; flat locally finitely presented for fppf; syntomic for syntomic; smooth for smooth; étale for étale; open immersion for Zariski—the composite $f\circ a:X'\to Y$ has $\mathcal P$.
stage_b_review_note: Preserves τ-local-on-source property under precomposition with admissible flat/fppf/syntomic/smooth/étale/open maps X'→X. Distinguishes precomposition from target base change.

stage_b_reviewed_content.statement: Let $\tau$ be one of Zariski, fpqc, fppf, étale, smooth, or syntomic. A property $\mathcal P$ of morphisms of schemes is *$\tau$-local on the source* if for every $f:X\to Y$ and every $\tau$-covering $\{a_i:X_i\to X\}$ one has $\mathcal P(f)$ if and only if $\mathcal P(f\circ a_i)$ for every $i$. If $\mathcal P$ is $\tau$-local on the source and $f:X\to Y$ has $\mathcal P$, then for any $a:X'\to X$ in the class corresponding to $\tau$—flat for fpqc; flat locally finitely presented for fppf; syntomic for syntomic; smooth for smooth; étale for étale; open immersion for Zariski—the composite $f\circ a:X'\to Y$ has $\mathcal P$.
hypotheses: P is tau-local on source; f has P; a is an indicated tau-type map.

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-properties-morphisms-local-source}
Let $\mathcal{P}$ be a property of morphisms of schemes.
Let $\tau \in \{fpqc, \linebreak[0] fppf, \linebreak[0]
\etale, \linebreak[0] smooth, \linebreak[0] syntomic\}$.
Assume that
\begin{enumerate}
\item the property is preserved under precomposing with
flat, flat locally of finite presentation, \'etale, smooth or syntomic morphisms
depending on whether $\tau$ is fpqc, fppf, \'etale, smooth, or syntomic,
\item the property is Zariski local on the source,
\item the property is Zariski local on the target,
\item for any morphism of affine schemes $f : X \to Y$, and
any surjective morphism of affine schemes $X' \to X$
which is flat, flat of finite presentation,
\'etale, smooth or syntomic depending on whether $\tau$ is
fpqc, fppf, \'etale, smooth, or syntomic, property
$\mathcal{P}$ holds for $f$ if property $\mathcal{P}$
holds for the composition $f' : X' \to Y$.
\end{enumerate}
Then $\mathcal{P}$ is $\tau$ local on the source.
stage_a_standalone_statement_draft: Let $\tau$ be one of Zariski, fpqc, fppf, étale, smooth, or syntomic. A property $\mathcal P$ of morphisms of schemes is *$\tau$-local on the source* if for every $f:X\to Y$ and every $\tau$-covering $\{a_i:X_i\to X\}$ one has $\mathcal P(f)$ if and only if $\mathcal P(f\circ a_i)$ for every $i$. Choose $\tau\in\{\mathrm{fpqc},\mathrm{fppf},\mathrm{\acute etale},\mathrm{smooth},\mathrm{syntomic}\}$. Suppose a morphism property $\mathcal P$ satisfies (1) preservation under precomposition by, respectively, flat, flat locally finitely presented, étale, smooth, or syntomic morphisms according to the choice of $\tau$; (2) Zariski locality on the source; (3) Zariski locality on the target; and (4) descent from the composite $X'\to X\xrightarrow fY$ to $f$ whenever $X'\to X$ is a surjective affine morphism of the indicated type and $X,Y$ are affine. Then $\mathcal P$ is $\tau$-local on the source.
stage_b_review_note: Preserves four sufficient hypotheses for τ-locality on source: stability under precomposition in corresponding class, Zariski locality on source, Zariski locality on target, and descent along all affine surjective maps of corresponding class.

A property $\mathcal P$ of morphisms of schemes is *$\tau$-local on the source* if for every $f:X\to Y$ and every $\tau$-covering $\{a_i:X_i\to X\}$ one has $\mathcal P(f)$ if and only if $\mathcal P(f\circ a_i)$ for every $i$. Choose $\tau\in\{\mathrm{fpqc},\mathrm{fppf},\mathrm{\acute etale},\mathrm{smooth},\mathrm{syntomic}\}$. Suppose a morphism property $\mathcal P$ satisfies (1) preservation under precomposition by, respectively, flat, flat locally finitely presented, étale, smooth, or syntomic morphisms according to the choice of $\tau$; (2) Zariski locality on the source; (3) Zariski locality on the target; and (4) descent from the composite $X'\to X\xrightarrow fY$ to $f$ whenever $X'\to X$ is a surjective affine morphism of the indicated type and $X,Y$ are affine. hypotheses: P stable under precomposition, Zariski-local on source and target, and descends along the corresponding surjective affine maps.
conclusions: P is tau-local on the source.
